description: This file defines interfaces and class declarations related to a DM client used for managing provider queries and notifications. It includes classes for proxying provider interactions, handling callback notifications, and creating/destroying DM client instances.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: A class intended for provider proxy operations, currently without public methods.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: Abstract class defining callback methods for query results and errors.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: Interface class for DM client operations, including creation, destruction, and query execution.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a query result is available.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback method invoked when an error occurs during a query.

methods.name: runQuery
methods.description: Executes a provider operation query with specified parameters, notifying via dmClientNotifier.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a dmClient object given a data model directory and log level.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Static method to delete a dmClient object.
